editingPrinciples.basis: Transfers an editing operation on reviewed detail; the explicit scope prohibits transferring this setting to unrelated selected meanings.

Requires locally operative conditions and blocks later definite claims from borrowing an earlier if. The supplied examples preserve scope. Paragraph distance is a reason to reassess scope, not a requirement to repeat a clause mechanically.
Explicitly blocks new speed/ease/frequency/necessity and modal loss. It correctly distinguishes calculation facts from interpretive possibilities.
Requires a supported object/choice and an optional, scene-bound direction. It does not license a new setting, supplied script or promised life outcome.
Correctly treats bodies as authored review artifacts and excludes them as prompt material, replacement benchmarks or evidence of generated quality.

transferContract.assessment: Moving abstract material.meaning to controls.sourceMeanings while retaining source-bound sceneDetails/practicalDistinction/optionalDirections as drafting material is source-safe if exact source bindings, full parent closure, requiredConditions and limitations remain available and enforced. Relocation alone is not evidence of generated quality.
transferContract.providerPrinciples: Use only short generic editing moves in shared provider guidance. The reviewed artifact's sourceIds and example strings belong to the review, not unconditional global instructions. A source-specific example may only enter a provider request when its exact selected source and complete parents support it.
transferContract.fixedSetting: Do not transfer the afternoon, check, calendar, note or tab to other source contexts as a standing setting. Other contexts need their own reviewed source-bound material.
transferContract.futureValidation: The actual revised projection, prompt and validator require separate implementation review; this source review does not certify bytes that have not yet been written.
